cards.title: N'kai Button Interaction: Native IPC vs Flash Subagent PCDA
cards.summary: Formal architectural verdict on whether to use a background Flash LLM subagent for button routing. Verdict: REJECT the LLM subagent (🪦 GRAVEYARD); use Antigravity Native UI Extension IPC (window.sidecar.agent.sendMessage) in 0ms with 0 tokens, keeping the clipboard composer for standalone browser boards.
angles: Thesis: Hands-free background routing via lightweight LLM
Antithesis: LLM for plumbing burns 2x tokens, adds 1-2s latency, risks prompt drift
Synthesis: Zero-cost native IPC for official extension; instant clipboard fallback for external browser
cards.next_action: Mark GRAVEYARD in ledger.

cards.title: Mailbag System Architecture: Modular 3-File Split & Audit Hardening
cards.summary: Unified proposal merging Opus's 3-file modular refactor of the check_mail.py monolith with the architectural enhancements identified in the morning archive audit: decomposing into tools/mailbag/ (scan, overlay, cli), dual-stage vault scanning (Inbox + Archive) with deterministic deduplication, incremental mtime/hash caching, and multi-vault contained directory routing for personal research.
angles: Modular 3-File Decomposition (Opus): Split 1,600+ line check_mail.py into tools/mailbag/scan.py (vault discovery & frontmatter), tools/mailbag/overlay.py (rejigger reconciliation & status preservation), and tools/check_mail.py (backward-compatible CLI facade) to slash ~196k subagent context overhead

Dual-Stage Zero-Loss Reconciliation (Audit Gap): Unify active Inbox/ and historical Inbox/Archive/ into a persistent, dual-index ledger with deterministic note hashing so moving notes to Archive never wipes verdicts or metadata
Incremental MTime/Hash Caching: Cache note parse trees by file mtime and SHA-256 so re-scanning 80+ notes drops from seconds to sub-10ms
Multi-Vault & Contained Directory Routing: Decouple scanner from hardcoded TheKlangVault/Inbox to support arbitrary folders (--dir <path>) for isolated personal/creative research without git sync
Multi-Source Provenance & Deep Links: Render clickable file:/// links and word counts for all merged source notes directly in card response drawers

cards.title: Interactive Stream-of-Consciousness Feedback & Live Reading Notes Protocol
cards.summary: Codify an interactive pair-programming mechanism that allows the developer to capture incremental, stream-of-consciousness reactions as they read long architectural teardowns (PCDAs, specs, audit reports) before reaching discussion, without losing thoughts or feeling constrained by linear reading.
angles: Live Reading Note Capture: Developer reads long dialectics section-by-section and dumps gut reactions as they read ('presentation notes mode')
Non-Judgmental Buffer: Agent explicitly buffers and reconciles incremental user feedback against later sections without patronizing or dismissing early reactions
UI Sidecar Tooling: Potential future N'kai widget or chat command (/stream-notes or inline margin notes) allowing paragraph-level reactions

cards.title: Mega-Vault Consolidation & Scoped Vault Enclave Architecture (Zettelkasten)
cards.summary: Architectural blueprint for consolidating multiple fragmented Obsidian vaults into a single unified personal knowledge base (PKB / Zettelkasten), restricting the developer AI tooling harness to a scoped sub-enclave (TheKlangVault/New Klang City/ or similar) while providing unified global access and pre-migration health scanning for plugins/cruft.
angles: Single Unified Obsidian Vault: Merge multi-vault sprawl into one unified Zettelkasten, increasing daily usage and cognitive cohesion
Sub-Enclave Boundary: Restrict TheKlangSuite/N'kai AI harness strictly to a scoped folder (e.g. vault/New Klang City/) so agents never touch or leak personal/creative notes
Vault Pre-Migration Health Scanner: Tooling script to audit external vaults before merge (checking for broken plugins, bloated cache, circular links, and filename hazards)
